Rekey requests: These are billable and go to estimates. If unsure, change the type to Key Request so DeAnn or Melanie will process.

Requests for key requests or building access--do not process. Refer to My Service now to submit a proper key request. Document action taken and reject request.

Lantana and Century Hall - fob reader/card access are managed by Capstone. On the Work Order assign to RFMT-POLY

ISAAC requests - refer student to their MyASU and press help. There is a phone number, live chat or email and reject the request. Do not email isaac-q@asu.edu

Mullion removal = Zone

ADA doors are critical and the Zone Supervisor should be called.

For RFMT: missing or damaged ceiling tiles, process to the correct zone, then go into the WO, enter the subtype of vandalism

The new fire system for Adelphi, Sonora needs to go to TMPE-Fire

For Fire Reports talking about Climatec records: send to TMPE-Fire

For RFMT requests for TMPE-Fire, RC must be TMPE

RFMT work orders for TMPE: RC must be TMPE

POLY-GRNDS: Dispatch Jesus Vasquez (602-418-9651) or Ruben Camacho (602-329-7365)

Cleaning blood off of concrete goes to EHS

Cabinets with missing/broken keys, furniture moves, raise/lower beds the task is 27020 Property Control. Trade = MVRS RC=TMPE, POLY, WEST
FACMAN does not provide rails or offer installation services.

Per University Housing: There are to be NO bidet, shower head replacements, or any type of domestic water modifications to the dorm rooms. If you receive a workorder requesting any type of modification, please notify University Housing.

Pest control for Res life: Priority is Routine always. A vendor comes every Wednesday,

Zone DOES NOT work on big water jugs/cooler. Please have student pull bottle off of the cooler. Call the zone to have a fan to dry the floor.

No cleaning of refrigerators in the dorm rooms or lounges

Sign requests should not go to estimates

RC would need to be TMPE if Res Life

Calls for needing approval to hang signs on campus: refer to brandguide.asu.edu/requests/approvals/signage
